title: MoE Ethiopian Exit Exam: Construction Technology and Management (2015)
description: Official Ministry of Education (MoE) Ethiopian University Exit Examination for Construction Technology and Management (2015). Complete with detailed explanations.

questions.questionText: The most suitable stone for building piers is
questions.explanation: Granite is known for its durability, compressive strength, and resistance to weathering, making it ideal for building piers which need to withstand high loads and harsh environmental conditions over long periods.

questions.questionText: The correct sequence in increasing order of oxides percentage in an ordinary Portland cement is
questions.explanation: In ordinary Portland cement, the typical oxide composition by percentage is: Al2O3 (5-10%) < SiO2 (17-25%) < CaO (60-67%). This sequence reflects the fundamental composition that gives Portland cement its characteristic properties.

questions.questionText: What are the advantages of construction equipment rent as compared to purchasing?
options: Avoid major repair costs and expenses
Save time and effort when seeking out equipment
questions.explanation: Renting construction equipment offers multiple advantages including: avoiding major repair costs, eliminating the need for long-term storage, accessing equipment only when needed, reducing capital expenditure, flexibility for different project requirements, and immediate availability for emergencies.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is true about equipment ownership cost?
options: Are variable costs that are incurred each year
Are the costs incurred only when the equipment is used
Are fixed costs that are incurred each year
Are costs incurred due to maintenance and repairing
questions.explanation: Equipment ownership costs are generally fixed costs incurred annually regardless of equipment usage. These include depreciation, interest on investment, insurance, taxes, and storage costs that must be paid whether the equipment is used or not.

questions.questionText: Which one the following entails true about Architect and Engineer?
options: Building construction is primarily of an architect
Engineering and industrial construction more often is for engineer
Owning drawings and specifications and reuse is matter of the AE
questions.explanation: All statements are true about architects and engineers: architects primarily focus on building construction design, engineers typically handle industrial and infrastructure projects, and both professionals have intellectual property rights over their drawings and specifications unless contractually specified otherwise.

questions.questionText: Any modification to the contractual guidance provided to the contractor by the Employer or Employer's representative is called
questions.explanation: A change order is a formal document that modifies the original contract terms, scope, time, or cost as agreed upon by all parties. While variation orders are similar, change orders are the comprehensive term for any contractual modification regardless of whether it adds, omits, or alters the work.

questions.questionText: Bodies who are given the mandate to look after urban housing construction and its associated legalities are
options: Ministry of Works and Urban Development
questions.explanation: Municipalities are responsible for overseeing urban housing construction, including issuing building permits, enforcing building codes, zoning regulations, land use planning, and ensuring compliance with local construction standards within their jurisdictional areas.

questions.questionText: Is the assessment of the firm's past, present and future financial conditions.
questions.explanation: Financial analysis is the systematic examination of a firm's financial data across time periods to evaluate stability, profitability, solvency, and liquidity. It uses various tools like ratio analysis, comparative statements, and trend analysis to assess past performance and forecast future financial health.

questions.questionText: From the following one is odd
questions.explanation: Random specification does not fit with the other structured types of specifications. Proprietary, performance, and prescriptive specifications are standard industry terms for different specification approaches, while 'random specification' is not a recognized formal specification type in construction documentation.

questions.questionText: To produce low heat cements, it is necessary to reduce the compound
questions.explanation: Reducing C3S (tricalcium silicate) content is essential in producing low heat cements because C3S generates the most heat during hydration. Low heat cements typically have higher C2S content (which hydrates more slowly and generates less heat) and reduced C3A content (which also contributes to heat generation).

questions.questionText: Assume that activity A is the start of project and Activity B depends on A and activity C depends on activity B. Each activity its optimistic, most likely and pessimistic times are Activity A (2, 6, and 8) days, Activity B (3, 9 and 12) days, Activity C (2, 8 and 10) days respectively then the expected time of this project is
questions.explanation: Using the PERT formula: Expected time = (Optimistic + 4×Most Likely + Pessimistic)/6. For Activity A: (2+4×6+8)/6 = 5.67 days. For Activity B: (3+4×9+12)/6 = 8.5 days. For Activity C: (2+4×8+10)/6 = 7.33 days. The total expected project time is the sum: 5.67 + 8.5 + 7.33 = 21.5 days.

questions.questionText: Which construction equipment is correctly matched with their application in construction industry?
options: Face shovel - excavation of canals and depositing on the embankment without hauling unit
Clamshell - vertical lifting loose material such as crushed stone, sand, gravel and coal
Back hoe - digging above machine level like trenches, footings and basements
questions.explanation: The clamshell is correctly matched with its application for vertical lifting of loose materials. Face shovels excavate above track level and load into hauling units, backhoes dig below track level (not above) for trenches and foundations, while clamshells use a vertical lift motion ideal for handling loose materials like sand and gravel.

questions.questionText: Which of the following type of construction correctly matched with the level of equipment usage?
questions.explanation: Highway construction typically requires intensive equipment usage due to the large earthmoving operations, material handling, paving, compaction, and grading activities across extended areas. The extensive nature of highway work demands continuous equipment operation over long distances compared to other construction types.

questions.questionText: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
questions.explanation: Limestone is correctly classified as a sedimentary rock formed from the accumulation of calcium carbonate deposits from marine organisms. Sandstone is also sedimentary (not igneous), basalt is igneous (not metamorphic), and granite is igneous (not argillaceous which refers to clay-rich rocks).

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is correct about back hoe?
options: Cable controlled & it makes outward strokes while digging.
Can dig and dump over larger distances than another shovel can do
Dragging softer material and above its track level
A shovel family construction equipment digging below machine level like trenches, footings, basements.
questions.explanation: Backhoes are hydraulically-powered excavation equipment designed specifically for digging below machine level. They are ideal for trenches, footings, and basements because they pull the bucket toward the machine (not outward), allowing efficient excavation below grade with good operator visibility of the digging area.

questions.questionText: Are tapering steps which are provided for changing the direction of stair
questions.explanation: Winders are triangular or tapering steps specifically designed to change the direction of a staircase without requiring a landing. Unlike straight flights that need landings to change direction, winders save space by allowing the stair to turn while maintaining continuous steps around the corner.

questions.questionText: Which factors are affecting the cost of owning and operating?
options: Number of hours not used per year
The cost of the equipment delivered to the owner
Number of years it is used
questions.explanation: Both the initial cost of equipment (purchase price plus delivery and setup) and the duration of ownership (years of use) significantly affect total ownership costs. Equipment costs are typically amortized over their useful life, so both the purchase price and duration directly impact the annual ownership cost calculation.

questions.questionText: During hydration of cement, the reaction of C3A with water is very violent and leads to immediate stiffening of the paste, to prevent this from happening which one of the following should be added to the cement clinker?
questions.explanation: CaSO4 (calcium sulfate/gypsum) is added to cement clinker to control the rapid reaction of C3A (tricalcium aluminate) with water. It works by forming calcium sulfoaluminate (ettringite) which creates a protective layer around C3A particles, slowing down their hydration and preventing flash setting. This allows proper workability time for the concrete or mortar.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is different from others?
questions.explanation: Special item cost is different from the others as it's not a regular operational cost. Fuel consumption, repairs and maintenance, and insurance are all standard recurring operating costs for equipment, while special item costs refer to non-routine expenditures that may be project-specific or one-time expenses.

questions.questionText: For high strength concrete the best aggregate is
questions.explanation: Angular aggregates provide better interlocking and stronger bond with cement paste in high-strength concrete. The angular faces create mechanical interlock between particles and increase the surface area for cement bonding, resulting in greater compressive strength compared to rounded aggregates which have smoother surfaces and less mechanical resistance.

questions.questionText: Which one is incorrect about CPM?
options: Used when unfamiliar or new activities
Used where times can be estimated with confidence
Uses one value of activity time
questions.explanation: CPM (Critical Path Method) is NOT used for unfamiliar or new activities. CPM is typically used for activities with predictable durations where times can be estimated with confidence. For unfamiliar activities with uncertain durations, PERT (Program Evaluation and Review Technique) is more appropriate as it incorporates probability and uses three time estimates.

questions.questionText: Which one is incorrect statement?
questions.explanation: The statement 'Always realize that FF ≥ TFD' is incorrect. Free float (FF) can be less than total float (TF) in certain scenarios. Free float is the amount of time an activity can be delayed without delaying the early start of any successor activities, while total float is the amount of time an activity can be delayed without delaying project completion.

questions.questionText: From Construction Accidents Breakdown of fatalities according to type of accident in construction industry which one is most happen?
options: Trapped by something collapsing or overturning
Contact with electricity or electrical discharge
questions.explanation: Falls from height are consistently the leading cause of fatalities in the construction industry globally, accounting for approximately one-third of all construction-related deaths. This is why fall protection requirements are emphasized in safety regulations and typically receive priority in safety training and inspection programs.

questions.questionText: Assume that you are assigned as a project manager of one leading construction company and have got soil investigation report as hard rock, so which construction equipment's do you prefer to excavate as an expert according to the principle of soil investigation factor?
questions.explanation: A splitter (rock splitter or hydraulic splitter) is the most appropriate equipment for hard rock excavation. Unlike draglines and clamshells which are designed for loose material, or dozers which are for pushing material, splitters use wedges or expanding forces to break apart solid rock formations with controlled pressure, reducing vibration and noise compared to blasting methods.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not true with regards to replacement of cement partly by puzzolana in making concrete?
questions.explanation: Pozzolana typically increases (not reduces) setting time when used as partial cement replacement. While pozzolanic materials improve concrete impermeability, sulfate resistance, and reduce bleeding/segregation, they slow down the initial hydration reactions, resulting in longer setting times compared to ordinary Portland cement.

questions.questionText: The three reasons of Time Value of Money are what?
questions.explanation: Liquidity, risk, and inflation are the three fundamental factors explaining the time value of money concept. Liquidity refers to preference for present consumption, risk reflects uncertainty of future returns, and inflation reduces purchasing power over time - all justifying why money today is worth more than the same amount in the future.

questions.questionText: The functional requirements of wall are
questions.explanation: The primary functional requirement of walls is stability under various loads, including seismic forces. Walls should resist, not facilitate, heat and sound transmission (so B and C are incorrect). Skid resistance is relevant for floor surfaces, not walls. Structural stability, including during seismic events, is a fundamental requirement for any wall system.

questions.questionText: An industry involved in construction of civil works and structures designed in accordance with:
questions.explanation: Civil works construction must adhere to both drawings/specifications (which provide project-specific requirements) and applicable codes/standards (which establish minimum safety and performance requirements). These two elements form the comprehensive technical basis for proper construction execution in compliance with both project needs and regulatory requirements.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is true about specifications?
options: Determines the progress of construction works
Gives detail information of the contract type of the projects
Labor resources also included in the construction specification
questions.explanation: All statements are true about specifications. Comprehensive specifications outline quality standards, materials, workmanship, testing requirements, and acceptance criteria that determine construction progress. They detail contractual requirements and may include labor resource specifications for specialized work or quality assurance requirements.

questions.questionText: In the case of pre-qualification which proposal check first?
options: Both Technical & Financial Proposal check at the same time
questions.explanation: In pre-qualification processes, technical proposals are evaluated first to ensure bidders meet the technical capabilities, experience, and competence requirements. Only after bidders pass the technical evaluation threshold are their financial proposals considered, which helps prevent awarding contracts based solely on lowest price without adequate technical capability.

questions.questionText: Horizontal member of a frame, which is employed to subdivide a window opening horizontally is
questions.explanation: A transom is a horizontal member that divides window openings. It creates separate glazing areas within the same window frame, allowing for different types of glazing or operable sections. While lock rails are horizontal members in doors where locks are installed, and frames encompass the entire window, only transoms specifically serve the horizontal subdivision function.

questions.questionText: Choose one stair that different in category
questions.explanation: Well stairs are distinct from the other types listed as they refer to stairs built around an open space or 'well' between flights. Newel, straight, and geometrical stairs are all classified based on their shape or configuration, while well stairs are categorized based on the presence of the central void or open space they surround.

questions.questionText: Differentiate the right statement
questions.explanation: The correct statement is 'Wall supports roof structures.' Floors should not tolerate moisture percolation, foundations distribute (not eliminate) load intensity, and escalators are moving (not stationary) stairs. Only the statement about walls supporting roof structures is technically accurate as this is one of the primary structural functions of walls.

questions.questionText: The most suitable type of equipment for compaction of cohesive soils are
questions.explanation: Sheep foot rollers are most effective for compacting cohesive soils like clay and silty soils. Their protruding feet apply high pressure at small contact areas, creating a kneading action that rearranges soil particles and expels air. Smooth rollers are better for granular soils, while vibratory rollers are most effective for non-cohesive materials.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is the real responsibility of contractors?
questions.explanation: Rectifying defects is a primary responsibility of contractors during both construction and the defects liability period. Project scope definition is typically the client's or designer's responsibility, obtaining permits is often shared or client-driven, and accessing infrastructure may be either party's responsibility depending on the contract.

questions.questionText: The correct sequence in the manufacturing of the bricks is
questions.explanation: The correct sequence for brick manufacturing is: 1) Weathering - exposing clay to atmosphere to break down organic matter and improve plasticity; 2) Tempering - adding water and mixing to achieve consistent workable clay; 3) Moulding - shaping the prepared clay into brick forms; followed by drying and firing. This sequence ensures proper material preparation before forming the bricks.

questions.questionText: Defined as the uppermost part of the building, provided as a structural covering, to protect the building from weather
questions.explanation: The roof structure is the complete assembly that forms the uppermost protective covering of a building. While corrugated metal sheet is just one roofing material, roof trusses are structural components within the roof, and pitch refers to the slope angle. The roof structure encompasses all elements that provide weather protection.

questions.questionText: A floor consisting of rigid concrete bed, geotextile membrane, insulated screed and good surface finish is
questions.explanation: A solid floor is characterized by a rigid concrete bed with layers built directly on the ground. The described system with a concrete base, geotextile membrane for moisture protection, insulation layer with screed, and surface finish is the definition of a solid floor construction. Suspended floors, by contrast, have a void beneath them.

questions.questionText: It represents the amount of work that has actually been accomplished or actually executed to date, expressed as the initial budget for that work.
questions.explanation: Earned Value (EV) is the measure of work actually completed, expressed in terms of the authorized budget. Unlike Planned Value (budgeted cost of scheduled work) or Actual Cost (real cost incurred), EV represents the physical progress translated into monetary value to enable objective measurement of project performance.

questions.questionText: From the following the correct statement in formwork construction is
options: Shuttering – Camber and cleaning – Propping and centering – Surface treatment
Centering and Propping – Surface treatment – Camber and cleaning – Shuttering
Propping and centering – Shuttering – Camber and cleaning – Surface treatment
Camber and cleaning – Shuttering – Propping and cleaning – Surface treatment
questions.explanation: The correct sequence for formwork construction begins with shuttering (erecting form panels), followed by camber and cleaning (ensuring proper elevation and cleanliness), then propping and centering (providing support and alignment), and finally surface treatment (applying release agents). This sequence ensures structural integrity and proper concrete finish.

questions.questionText: The financial manager analyzes that ABC Consultant Company has an Intermediate-term of finance categories. An auditor wants to audit the budget allocated for the company in three years of time basis. Which of the following elements not taken as the check-list for an auditor?
questions.explanation: Revolving profit agreements are typically not included in budget audits of intermediate-term finance categories. While leases, insurance policies, and pension fund allocations are standard financial obligations with predictable payment schedules that auditors would review, revolving profit agreements relate to profit distribution rather than budgetary allocation and are therefore outside the scope of standard budget audits.

questions.questionText: Who is the first responsible person for accidents occurring in the construction site if not safety engineer?
questions.explanation: The site engineer is typically the first responsible person for site safety in the absence of a dedicated safety engineer. Being directly involved in daily site operations and having technical knowledge of the construction process, site engineers are expected to identify hazards, implement safety measures, and ensure work is carried out according to safety standards and regulations.

questions.questionText: The project time can be determined by
questions.explanation: The critical path method determines the minimum project duration by identifying the sequence of activities with zero float that determines the earliest project completion time. While crashing, accelerating, and adding resources are techniques to reduce project duration, they don't determine the base project time - they modify it after the critical path has established the baseline duration.

questions.questionText: If you are assigned to supervise the project which one is incorrect responsibility?
options: Look after proper execution of project
questions.explanation: Rectifying defects is not the supervisor's responsibility but rather the contractor's obligation. The supervisor's role includes ensuring proper execution, administering the contract, certifying payments, and identifying defects for the contractor to rectify. The supervisor inspects and reports defects but does not perform the actual remedial work.

questions.questionText: Which of the following constituent in earth gives plasticity to mould bricks in suitable shape?
questions.explanation: Alumina (aluminum oxide, Al₂O₃) provides plasticity to clay for brick molding. While silica adds strength but contributes to brittleness, lime helps in fusion during firing, and magnesia affects shrinkage, it is the alumina component that gives clay its essential plastic properties allowing it to be shaped and hold its form during molding and drying processes.

questions.questionText: Structural curved skin covering a given plan shape and area where the forces in the shell or membrane are compressive and in the restraining edge beams are tensile is
questions.explanation: Dome structures are characterized by compressive forces in the curved shell and tensile forces in the edge beams or ring. This force distribution is a defining characteristic of domes, which efficiently transfer loads through their curved geometry. Hyperbolic parabolic structures have a different force distribution pattern, while plain structures lack the curved shell configuration described.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following cement is more intended for mass structures such as Gravity dam where you are going to cast mass of concrete at once?
questions.explanation: Low-Heat of Hydration Portland cement is specifically designed for mass concrete structures like gravity dams where thermal cracking is a major concern. The reduced heat generation during hydration minimizes temperature differentials within large concrete pours, preventing thermal stresses that could lead to cracking. High-Early-Strength cement would be particularly unsuitable as it generates more heat.

questions.questionText: The type of brick bond system comprises an alternative header and stretcher and often used to get good aesthetic view is
questions.explanation: Flemish bond alternates headers and stretchers in each course, creating a distinctive checkerboard pattern that is highly valued for its aesthetic appeal. Unlike English bond (alternating courses of headers and stretchers), Header bond (all headers), or Stretcher bond (all stretchers), Flemish bond combines both brick orientations within each course for decorative effect while maintaining structural integrity.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the correct process of brick production?
options: Excavation and storage – Tempering – Dryer chamber – Firing in kiln – Crack control
Clay preparation – Mixing – Sun dry – Firing in kiln – Sintering – Moulding
Grinding and blending – Moulding – Sun drying – Firing in kiln – Sintering
questions.explanation: The correct sequence for brick production is: excavation and storage (obtaining and stockpiling clay), tempering (adding water and mixing to achieve proper consistency), drying in dryer chambers (controlled moisture removal), firing in kiln (hardening through controlled high temperatures), and crack control (cooling gradually to prevent thermal cracking). This process ensures proper material preparation, forming, and conversion to durable ceramic products.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not taken as liquidity function of financial management for one CEO?
options: Managing the flow of internal funds
questions.explanation: Forecasting profit is not a liquidity function; it relates to profitability management. Liquidity functions focus on ensuring the organization has sufficient cash to meet short-term obligations, which includes forecasting cash flows, raising funds when needed, and managing internal fund flows. Profit forecasting, while important for overall financial planning, addresses income generation rather than cash availability.

questions.questionText: A horizontal member of stair is known as:
questions.explanation: The horizontal member of a stair is called the tread, which is the part stepped on.

questions.questionText: A current ratio of less than one means:
questions.explanation: A current ratio below 1 indicates that current liabilities exceed current assets (Current Assets < Current Liabilities), signaling potential liquidity issues and an inability to pay short-term obligations.

questions.questionText: A steep raised element of a roadway that provides drainage control, roadway edge delineation, right-of-way reduction and delineation of pedestrian walkways is called:
questions.explanation: Curbs are raised elements along roadways that serve multiple functions, including drainage control and pedestrian safety.

questions.questionText: A worker is carrying reinforcing bars of diameter 20 mm, measuring between 3 m and 4 m, on his bicycle. The bars were projecting about 1.5 m–2 m on both sides longitudinally. While taking a turn at roundabout, it hit two pedestrians causing scratches to both of them. What is the principal cause of this accident?
options: The cause is beyond the control of the site
A combination of unsafe act and unsafe condition
questions.explanation: This is clearly an unsafe act. Transporting long materials improperly without securing them or using appropriate vehicles is a violation of safety protocols. The worker should have used a proper vehicle designed for transporting long materials or ensured they were properly secured and marked with safety flags.

questions.questionText: A trench 1 m wide and 3 m deep is excavated and the walls are secured with appropriately driven steel sheets. Workers walking on the heap of earth removed from the trench slip and fall into the trench, causing one of them to have a fractured hand. What is the principal cause of this accident?
options: The cause is beyond the control of the site
A combination of unsafe act and unsafe condition
questions.explanation: The accident resulted from both an unsafe condition (unstable heap of earth placed too close to the trench edge) and an unsafe act (workers walking on the unstable heap without proper precautions). Proper safety procedures would include stabilizing the heap, keeping excavated soil away from the trench edge, and prohibiting walking on excavated materials.

questions.questionText: Among the documents forming a contract document, the priority of BOQs, specifications and drawings while making interpretations in case if any ambiguities among them shall generally be:
options: The specification, the priced BOQ and the drawings
The priced BOQ, the specifications and the drawings
The drawings, the specification and the priced BOQ
The specifications, the drawings and the priced BOQ
questions.explanation: Specifications typically take precedence over BOQs and drawings in resolving ambiguities.

questions.questionText: Among the following which one is not an objective for the construction of the dam?
options: Providing water supply for domestic and industrial purposes
To make sure rains occur periodically
questions.explanation: Dams are not constructed to influence rainfall patterns.

questions.questionText: Among the following who is not interested in financial statement of a company?
questions.explanation: Previous employees generally have no ongoing interest in a company's financial statements.

questions.questionText: Among the following, which one is not the advantage of preventive maintenance over corrective maintenance?
options: Health and safety of the user can be improved
Maintenance costs can be reduced by avoiding the cost of consequential damage
questions.explanation: Preventive maintenance reduces downtime, not increases it.

questions.questionText: Among the following, which one is not the benefit of Building Information Modeling (BIM)?
options: It cannot be used for creating as-built documentation for existing buildings
It helps to eliminate inefficiencies of the construction process
It helps to integrate schedule and cost data with the analysis and design process
The data-rich model can be used throughout the life cycle of a building
questions.explanation: This statement is incorrect as BIM can indeed be used for creating as-built documentation for existing buildings through laser scanning and point cloud technology. The other options are all valid benefits of BIM.

questions.questionText: As one of the following factor increases, the project cash flow is affected positively:
questions.explanation: A higher profit margin positively impacts cash flow by increasing the net cash received from each payment. The other options negatively affect cash flow: higher retention amounts reduce immediate payments, longer certification periods delay payments, and under-measurement reduces payment amounts.

questions.questionText: As per Ethiopian road administration, a terrain with hilly or foothill country where the slopes generally rise and fall moderately and where occasional steep slopes are encountered is classified as:
questions.explanation: Rolling terrain is characterized by moderate slopes and occasional steep areas.

questions.questionText: Carelessness is the cause of an accident that can be attributed to:
questions.explanation: Carelessness is typically an individual employee's fault.

questions.questionText: For 21.6 cm thick and 100 sq. m concrete floor slab, if the mix proportion is 1:2:3, how many quintals of cement will be required? Assume 1 bag of cement is 0.036 m3.
questions.explanation: Volume of concrete = 21.6 cm × 100 m² = 0.216 m × 100 m² = 21.6 m³. For 1:2:3 mix, cement is 1/(1+2+3) = 1/6 of total volume. Cement required = 21.6 × (1/6) = 3.6 m³. In bags: 3.6 ÷ 0.036 = 100 bags. Since 1 quintal = 2 bags, cement required = 100 ÷ 6 = 16.67 quintals.

questions.questionText: From the following compaction equipment, which one is generally not suitable for use on cohesionless granular materials?
questions.explanation: Sheep foot rollers are designed for cohesive soils, not granular materials.

questions.questionText: Given the network diagram below, what's the critical path?
questions.explanation: The critical path is the longest path in the network diagram that determines the total project duration. Without seeing the actual diagram, it would be path Start-A-B-C-End if that is the one with the longest total duration and zero float.

questions.questionText: Given the portion of the network diagram in the right, what's the EF of activity F?
questions.explanation: Early Finish (EF) = Early Start (ES) + Duration. Without seeing the actual diagram, if option c (61) is correct, this means the Early Start of activity F plus its duration equals 61.

questions.questionText: Hydraulic jump depends upon:
questions.explanation: Hydraulic jump is influenced by the initial speed of the fluid flow.

questions.questionText: If the moments induced by slenderness effects weaken a column appreciably, it is referred to as:
questions.explanation: Long columns experience significant secondary moments due to slenderness effects. As columns become more slender (higher length-to-width ratio), lateral deflection increases under axial loads, creating additional bending moments that can significantly reduce load-carrying capacity. Short columns, braced columns, and axially loaded columns do not experience these significant slenderness effects.

questions.questionText: In a staircase the continuous set of steps between floors and/or landing is known as:
questions.explanation: A flight refers to a continuous series of steps between landings.

questions.questionText: In bulk excavation the items on the BoQ differ based on their depth with a multiple of 1.5m, such as up to 1.5m, up to 3.0m and up to 4.5m. Which one of the following is necessarily true for such categorization?
questions.explanation: Productivity of excavation equipment varies with depth, justifying the categorization.

questions.questionText: In plain areas, the irrigation canals are usually aligned along:
questions.explanation: In plain areas, irrigation canals are typically aligned along ridge lines (watershed divides) to maximize the command area that can be irrigated by gravity flow. This positioning allows water to flow downhill on both sides of the canal.

questions.questionText: In reinforced rectangular beams, if concrete reaches its maximum design strength before steel reaches its maximum design strength (fyd), this type of failure is called:
questions.explanation: Compression failure occurs when concrete crushes before steel yields.

questions.questionText: In using wood for construction, knots are considered as:
options: A strong point in the timber
There is no need to consider their effects
questions.explanation: Knots weaken the wood and are considered defects.

questions.questionText: In which all courses of a pavement are either unbound or bound with a bituminous binder is called:
questions.explanation: Flexible pavements use bituminous materials throughout their layers.

questions.questionText: In which details of the survey are covered roughly but not accurately in route survey is called:
questions.explanation: A reconnaissance survey provides a rough overview without precise details.

questions.questionText: In which of the following areas the precautions should be mostly taken for drainage?
questions.explanation: Waterlogged areas require extensive drainage measures to prevent flooding.

questions.questionText: In your construction project if you have a maximum of 4 crews for a specific activity and the Forman's utilization factor is 0.5 for that specific work, how many Forman are required for that specific activity?
questions.explanation: With a utilization factor of 0.5, each foreman can effectively supervise 2 crews (0.5 × 4 = 2). Therefore, to supervise 4 crews, you need 4 ÷ 2 = 2 foremen. The utilization factor represents the portion of a resource that can be allocated to a specific task.

questions.questionText: One of the following does not affect construction project price determination.
questions.explanation: Tender evaluation is a process, not a factor affecting price determination.

questions.questionText: One of the following imparts mechanical energy into materials in order to improve their load carrying ability?
questions.explanation: Rollers compact materials, improving their load-bearing capacity.

questions.questionText: One of the following is not the purpose of specification:
options: It specifies the expected workmanship quality
It is used as a project management tool
It specifies the method of measurement
questions.explanation: Specifications define quality and methods, not work schedules.

questions.questionText: One of the following is the maximum distance through which excavated material may be transported without the added cost above the unit bid price in highway project:
questions.explanation: Free haul distance is the limit for no additional transport cost.

questions.questionText: The amount of compaction applied by equipment over a ground cannot be controlled by one of the following?
options: By the weight of the operator
The number of passes of compaction equipment
The speed of the compaction equipment
questions.explanation: The operator's weight does not influence compaction effectiveness.

questions.questionText: The defects like pot holes, corrugation, rutting can be rectified by:
questions.explanation: Grading helps smooth out surface defects like potholes and ruts.

questions.questionText: The fine aggregates are having a size less than:
questions.explanation: Fine aggregates are defined as particles smaller than 4.75mm.

questions.questionText: The force opposing movement of an equipment up a frictionless slope is called:
questions.explanation: Grade resistance is the component of the equipment's weight that acts parallel to the slope and opposes uphill movement. It is calculated as W × sin(θ) where W is the weight and θ is the slope angle. Unlike friction or rolling resistance, grade resistance exists even on frictionless surfaces and is purely the result of gravitational forces.

questions.questionText: The minimum depth of boreholes for shallow foundation for buildings is:
questions.explanation: A minimum depth of 3m is typically required for shallow foundations.

questions.questionText: The property of cement by which it doesn't expand is called:
questions.explanation: Soundness refers to the ability of cement to resist volume changes (expansion) after setting. A cement with good soundness will maintain its volume and not crack due to expansive compounds like free lime or magnesia. This is a critical property for durability and structural integrity.

questions.questionText: The raising of the centerline of the roadway above the elevation of the pavement edges in a sufficient way to provide adequate surface drainage whilst not being so great as to make steering difficult is called:
questions.explanation: Pavement crowns facilitate drainage by elevating the centerline.

questions.questionText: The safety valve of a dam is its :
questions.explanation: Spillways act as safety valves for dams by providing a controlled path for excess water to be released during floods. This prevents water from overtopping the dam, which could lead to erosion and potential dam failure. Spillways are critical safety features designed to handle peak flood discharges.

questions.questionText: The water sanitation project manager has determined the risks associated with handling certain chemicals are too high. He has decided to allow someone else to complete this portion of the project, and so has outsourced the handling and installation of the chemicals and filter equipment to an experienced contractor. This is an example of which of the following?
questions.explanation: This is a clear example of risk transference—shifting the risk responsibility to another party (the experienced contractor) who is better equipped to handle it. Risk acceptance would involve keeping the risk; mitigation would involve taking steps to reduce its impact while still doing the work; avoidance would mean changing the project to eliminate the risk entirely.

questions.questionText: What is the difference between Precedence Diagram (PDM) and Arrow Diagram (ADM) in a project scheduling?
options: PDM can use dummy activity while ADM cannot.
ADM places activities on arrows while PDM places activities on nodes.
ADM hosts activities on nodes while PDM hosts activities on arrows.
ADM is also known as AOA while PDM is also known as PERT.
questions.explanation: In Arrow Diagram Method (ADM), also known as Activity on Arrow (AOA), activities are represented on arrows connecting nodes (events). In Precedence Diagram Method (PDM), activities are represented on nodes with arrows showing relationships. ADM may require dummy activities to show logical relationships, while PDM can show various dependency types (FS, SS, FF, SF) without dummies.

questions.questionText: When does a soil sample may be regarded as well graded?
options: If it has excess amount of certain size particles
If it has good representation of particles of all size
If it has optimum amount of certain size particles
If it has most number of particles of same size
questions.explanation: Well-graded soil has a balanced distribution of particle sizes.

questions.questionText: Which of the following classification of door is based on types of material used?
questions.explanation: Battened and ledged doors are classified by their material and construction.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is correct about project scheduling software?
options: Software may not be much useful during planning phase of projects.
Project management software may give wrong results because of the speed with which it performs the forward and backward pass calculations.
More customized reports are possible in MS Project when compared to Primavera.
Resource leveling function can easily be done using project management software.
questions.explanation: Project management software greatly simplifies resource leveling—the process of resolving resource conflicts and overallocations across a project schedule. This complex process would be extremely time-consuming and error-prone if done manually. The other statements are incorrect: project management software is highly valuable in planning phases, provides accurate calculations regardless of processing speed, and both MS Project and Primavera offer extensive reporting capabilities.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not correct about the advantage of concrete structure?
options: Concrete system allows the designer to combine the architectural and structural functions.
Concrete has a good fire resistance capacity and it need less fire proofing.
If the concrete structure is built in high quality, then it requires less maintenance.
Concrete has high tensile strength which makes it to withstand cracks easily.
questions.explanation: Concrete has low tensile strength (approximately 1/10 of its compressive strength), which is why it's typically reinforced with steel in tension zones. It's prone to cracking under tensile stress, unlike options a, b, and c which are all legitimate advantages of concrete structures.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not necessarily the criterion to be considered in choosing construction materials at design stage?
options: Energy used for the production of the material
Availability of skilled manpower for the work
questions.explanation: Energy used in production is less critical than cost, availability, and skilled labor.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not the result of improper alignment of road?
questions.explanation: Road alignment does not directly affect population growth.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not the use of concrete cover to reinforcement in R.C.C?
options: To bond the reinforcement to the concrete
To protect the concrete against rusting
The protection of the steel against corrosion
questions.explanation: Concrete cover protects steel, not the concrete itself, from rusting.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the advantage of bar chart over network diagrams?
options: There is way of knowing logical interdependency of activities using bar chart
Bar charts are an excellent tool for visual representation of the plan of the project
Effect of delay in an activity can be easily assessed from bar charts
The criticality of an activity be easily assessed from bar charts
questions.explanation: Bar charts excel in visually representing project schedules.
